narrative:
JIMDO Net Sales after Credit Memos in the Q3 Forecast is EUR 72.0M, +16.1% against the EUR 62.0M budget.

Renewal Business is the largest billing type at EUR 38.2M (53% of group). Addons is furthest ahead of plan (EUR 1.2M); Service & Debt Collection is furthest behind (EUR -0.0M).

Key risk: the Service & Debt Collection gap widens if the volume drivers on the Scenarios page move against plan.

signals.title: Renewal net sales after CM EUR 37.9M in FY2026 (+19.9%)
signals.source: Topline Forecast — FC Summary, Renewal Business · Main
signals.excerpt: Main-plan renewals grow from EUR 31.6M (FY2025A) to EUR 37.9M on 274k renewed products (+20.0%). List price holds at about EUR 153; growth is volume from larger cohorts reaching their renewal date.

signals.title: First renewal is the biggest leak: 73.9% vs 81.3% retention
signals.source: Renew — Retention sheet, 12-month term, youngest vs older cohorts
signals.excerpt: Customers renewing for the first time retain at 73.9% on 12-month terms and 67.4% on 24-month terms, against 81.3% and 73.5% for older cohorts. Each point of retention across cohorts is worth about EUR 0.7M of FY2027 renewal net sales.

signals.title: Credit memos fall from EUR 1.20M to EUR 1.07M
signals.source: Net Sales after CM — Renewal Business · Main
signals.excerpt: Credit memo sales on renewals improve by EUR 0.13M year on year and drop to EUR 0.34M in FY2027 in the plan. The forecast assumes refunds on auto-renewals fall sharply; that assumption carries the most risk in the renewal bridge.
